integrity: Reproducible finite-field enumeration plus explicit independent algebraic isogeny and twist proofs; independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The finite-field Frobenius classification is proved for F_11; no claim of absolute simplicity or polarized isomorphism for the genus-four Jacobian; older local Euler tables could include the quotient polynomial. Geometric quotient isogeny is prior work.
title: Arithmetic descent of the two genus-two factors of the Accola–Maclachlan curve at eleven
